changes: Removed mandatory PAS algorithm, inevitable isolated-procedure failure, automatic circumferential degloving/grafting and universal escutcheon donor preference.

Rebuilt outcome table with Pariser, Staniorski and Plamadeala populations, actual follow-up and endpoints; scoped BMI thresholds and frailty associations to retrospective cohorts; removed automatic pediatric ligament/circumcision instructions.
unresolved: Most original studies remain abstract-only; full operative videos, figure graphics and study supplements were not accessed.

PAS operative percentages and Plamadeala table/PRO inconsistencies are not propagated; full-source limitations remain recorded.
This is a scoped substantive audit, not validation of every individual surgical maneuver or clinical clearance.

pages.title: Panniculectomy
pages.scope: Entire original and rewritten MDX, including all references, read. Revised paragraphs reread after link and language cleanup. Substantive review addressed indications, panniculectomy versus abdominoplasty, AABP/urostomy/transplant outcome denominators, mechanical safety, concurrent hernia repair and wound-care evidence. Current high-yield sources include KDIGO selected full section, the 2024 VHR-panniculectomy meta-analysis and 2022 Cochrane closed-incision NPWT review at the exact access scopes below.

Complete primary abstract read; four salvage patients, three improved appliance fit/leakage and one further operation. Full paper not accessed.

Complete primary abstract read; 12 studies in review, 11 comparative studies in meta-analysis, mixed abdominoplasty/panniculectomy/TRAM-DIEP donor sites. Full methods, graphics and supplements not accessed.

Complete Cochrane structured abstract and plain-language summary read; 62 RCTs, 13,340 participants. Moderate-certainty SSI reduction and probably little/no dehiscence difference; blister risk. Full review, appendices and graphics not accessed.

changes: Removed panniculectomy as an established SUI procedure and bariatric/rectus-plication extrapolation; separated muscle-tightening abdominoplasty from panniculectomy.
Qualified AABP classifications and observational risk estimates; corrected Staniorski total versus low-grade complications and whole-cohort denominator.

Aligned transplant selection with KDIGO individual assessment rather than universal BMI exclusion or mandatory panniculectomy. Corrected Troppmann recipient denominator and survival comparison; corrected Ngaage one-year follow-up versus eight-year accrual.
Limited urostomy contouring claims to four-patient salvage experience. Removed universal CT weight threshold, unsupported pretreatment and transfusion rules, and coverage guarantees.

Replaced routine suspension from OR lighting/penetrating fixation instructions with appropriate load-rated equipment and hernia assessment; emphasized limited undermining, perfusion and individual closure/drain decisions.
Added high-yield 2024 hernia meta-analysis showing increased wound morbidity with combined surgery, with precise comparator and observational limitations.
Reframed NPWT with 2022 Cochrane and 2025 mixed-procedure evidence; removed mandatory use and historical-comparator causality.
Reduced references to sources supporting retained claims, repaired female-SUI and perioperative-care links, and removed public correction-history phrasing.
unresolved: Most individual reconstructive outcome sources were accessible only as complete primary abstracts; no claim of full-paper assessment for those studies.

Original source retrieval returned 34 HTTP503 failures out of 39 DOI queries. Five available abstracts were fully read; exact-DOI matches from already-read AABP abstracts and separate direct primary sources were reused. A complete identity/claim audit of all removed original references was not performed.

Hampson source full paper/abstract was not completely accessed; Cao2026 only partial primary abstract was available. Their unsupported numerical and indication claims were removed rather than treated as verified.
Janis graphics/video, other study full methods/figures and Cochrane full appendices were not inspected. Its narrative operative practices are not universal contemporary protocols.
No source provides a validated individualized risk calculator, guaranteed SUI benefit, graft success or insurance coverage. This is a scoped substantive review, not clinical clearance.
